svg.title: Lumen Vision 460M: tensor compression, multimodal decoder and answer-supervised connector adaptation
svg.text: 512 × 512 tile • patch size 16 • one dense feature map per tile
Z ∈ ℝ¹⁰²⁴×⁷⁶⁸ → reshape / permute → ℝ⁶⁴×¹²²⁸⁸ → Zᵥ ∈ ℝ⁶⁴×⁹⁶⁰
Total visual tokens scale with the number of tiles; 64 is not the total for every image.
Visual token replacement → one causal attention stream
Prompt tokens are ignored; targets are shifted once before the original forward call.
The full answer + EOS is appended; training input excludes the last token (schematic).
L = − (1/N) ∑ₜ mₜ log p(yₜ | I, q, y₍<t₎)
θvision, θdecoder fixed; only W is updated.
Gradient propagates through the frozen decoder to the visual connector.
Blue / teal: visual tensors and backbone • Gold: text tokens • Purple: connector parameters / gradient • Green: answer targets
Lumen Vision 460M — tensor operations follow the implemented SigLIP2 / SmolLM2 base; schematic feature values, not measured attention.
Original architecture: Tether AI Research / VisionPsy Nano. Redrawn scientific illustration and connector adaptation tooling: Yifan Ouyang.
